text: 卖淫合法的话，男人获得性的渠道和成本会大大降低，
en: If prostitution were legalised, men's channels for obtaining sex and the cost would be greatly reduced,

text: 在男女矛盾日益加重的今天，可能会导致一部分男人取消结婚的打算
en: In today's world, where the conflict between men and women is increasingly intensifying, this could lead some men to abandon their plans to marry.

text: 比较十几万的彩礼够你体验上百个不同的女性了，
en: Compare that: a bride price of over a hundred thousand would be enough for you to experience over a hundred different women,

text: 那么，
en: Then,

text: 不结婚怎么让这些人买房，
en: How do you get these people to buy houses if they do not marry,

text: 不买房地价怎么抬高，
en: How do you push up land prices if they do not buy houses,

text: 地价低怎么供养老爷，
en: How do you support the masters if land prices are low,

text: 老爷没养肥中华民族怎么伟大复兴。
en: How can the Chinese nation achieve its great rejuvenation if the masters are not fattened up.

text: 你就这么反驳就行
en: All you need to do is argue back like this.

text: 目前法律存在一个矛盾，就是同样是出卖身体，卖淫非法而被包养合法——如果性不可以交易，那么被包养也应该非法，而且应当视为短期内多次卖淫，考虑到单次小金额盗窃不入刑、两年内三次盗窃则入刑，被包养应当不仅被视为违法、还应被视为犯罪加以刑责。
en: There is currently a contradiction in the law: that selling one's body is the same act, yet prostitution is illegal while being kept is legal — if sex cannot be traded, then being kept should also be illegal, and should be treated as repeated prostitution within a short period; considering that a single small-amount theft does not incur criminal liability while three thefts within two years do, being kept should be regarded not only as unlawful but also as a crime carrying criminal liability.

text: 作为一个保守主义者，我个人的看法是，一切伴随财产赠予的非婚性行为都应视为卖淫嫖娼，且按盗窃罪的范例，两年内三次卖淫嫖娼的，应加以刑责。
en: As a conservative, my personal view is that all non-marital sexual acts accompanied by the gifting of property should be regarded as prostitution, and following the precedent of the crime of theft, anyone who engages in prostitution three times within two years should bear criminal liability.

text: 一部分伴随财产赠予的非婚性行为被视为卖淫嫖娼，被当成违法行为加以打击，另一部分则因为持续时间较长、交易对象固定而拥有包养、援助交际或者其他什么乱七八糟的名义从而得以合法化，这是在法理上说不通的——举重以明轻，举轻以明重，若前者非法，后者因短时间内多次而显然是更严重的非法，相应的，若后者被视为合法且万难更改，前者就理应同样得到合法化。
en: Some non-marital sexual acts accompanied by the gifting of property are deemed prostitution and cracked down on as unlawful, while others are legalised under such labels as being kept, compensated dating, or other messy pretexts because they last longer and involve a fixed partner — this makes no sense in legal principle. To infer the lesser from the greater, and the greater from the lesser: if the former is unlawful, the latter, involving repeated acts within a short time, is clearly the more serious unlawfulness; correspondingly, if the latter is deemed lawful and extremely hard to change, then the former should likewise be legalised.

text: 所以，如何反驳支持卖淫合法化的人？
en: So, how do you refute those who support the legalisation of prostitution?

text: 我认为性不得交易，一切伴随财物赠予的非婚性行为，无论被冠以何种名义，都应被视为卖淫嫖娼，都应被当做违法行为加以打击，若短时间内发生多次卖淫嫖娼，比如俗称的“包养”关系，则应更进一步的被视为犯罪并加以刑责。
en: I hold that sex may not be traded; all non-marital sexual acts accompanied by the giving of money or goods, no matter what name they are given, should be regarded as prostitution and cracked down on as unlawful; if prostitution occurs repeatedly within a short period — such as in the so-called 'kept' relationship — then it should be further regarded as a crime and made to bear criminal liability.

text: 有好多回答都太保守了，只是借鉴其他国家目前的情况。
en: Many of the answers are too conservative, merely drawing on the current situation in other countries.

text: 但是事务是发展的，如果完全放开之后，
en: But affairs develop; if it were completely liberalised,

text: 从相关行业人员来讲，任何产业逃脱不了经济规律，对从业人员来说，这么大的产业合法化后，在刚开始的几年成为非常热门的行业后，很快也会因为从业人员饱和而面临就业危机和年龄危机等。
en: From the perspective of those in the relevant industry, no sector can escape economic laws; for the workers, after such a large industry is legalised and becomes hugely popular in the first few years, it will soon face an employment crisis and an age crisis as the workforce becomes saturated.

text: 对行业投资者来说，行业开始内卷后，也会开始进行产业升级，其他服务业的行业标准会被引进，根据各自定位向高端，低端，特色，链锁等不同的方向发展。
en: For industry investors, once the sector begins to experience involution, it will also start to upgrade; service standards from other industries will be introduced, and it will develop in different directions — high-end, low-end, distinctive, chain, and so on — according to each player's positioning.

text: 同时用工成本，房租成本，损耗成本等也一样会开始被重视，对经营者的挑战不再是胆量而是实际的经营能力。
en: At the same time, labour costs, rent, wear-and-tear costs and the like will also come to be taken seriously; the challenge for operators will no longer be nerve but actual managerial ability.

text: 再然后产业进入稳定期，同时也会有各种培训机构开始使用开办培训班提升你的工作能力，再然后被传统学校吸纳，开设相关选修课程，再然后对相关的多种专业进行融合形成新的专业，最后升为一级学科毕业后授予本科学位。
en: Then the industry enters a stable phase; meanwhile various training institutions will start running courses to improve your work skills; then it is absorbed by traditional schools, which offer relevant elective courses; then various related disciplines are merged to form a new field; and finally it is elevated to a first-level discipline, with a bachelor's degree awarded upon graduation.

text: 再然后毕业生就业难，就业环境差的问题同样会出现。
en: Then the problem of difficult graduate employment and a poor job market will likewise emerge.

text: 当然也不是像现在的地下场所一样完全无所谓，也会像打击其他行业使用童工一样打击该行业雇佣童工，进行消防检查，执照审核，依法纳税，劳动监察，物价监管等等。
en: Of course it would not be completely unregulated like today's underground venues; just as other industries are punished for using child labour, this industry too would be punished for hiring child labour, and would be subject to fire inspections, licence checks, paying tax according to law, labour supervision, price oversight and the like.

text: 长期来看的话，社会可以逐渐做到不歧视性工作者的时候，就可以放开了。
en: In the long run, once society can gradually stop discriminating against sex workers, then it can be liberalised.

text: 不过那样的时代的人看待家庭和结婚这两个概念，估计就像我们看古人被封建礼教束缚一样，只会感到恶心。
en: Yet people of such an era, looking at the two concepts of family and marriage, would probably feel only disgust, much as we look at the ancients bound by feudal rites.

text: 目前至少在我们国家，很多人所谓的想要搞完全是因为打工的地方离家太远以为脱离了家庭掌控了，以家庭为单位进行投票基本没人投支持。
en: At present, at least in our country, many people's so-called desire to push for it is entirely because their place of work is too far from home and they mistakenly think they have broken free of their family's control; if a vote were taken by household, basically no one would vote in favour.

text: 等未来某一天不结婚而且没有稳定恋爱对象的人成为40岁以上人员的主流，都成个人户家庭了，那才意味着这事儿该被抬上来讨论。
en: Only when, one day in the future, those who do not marry and have no stable partner become the mainstream among people over forty, and all become single-person households, will it mean that this matter should be put on the table for discussion.

text: 这个多米诺骨牌其实从允许婚外发生性行为就开始一步一步往下走了，到未来，跟你刚那啥过的女伴觉得还差点意思，然后通过APP叫一个小哥来满足一下像叫外卖一样轻松，大家都能看开了，也自然就不可能再立法禁止了。
en: This domino effect in fact began toppling step by step from the moment extramarital sex was permitted; by the future, a female companion you just slept with might feel something is still lacking, and then summon a young man through an app to satisfy her as easily as ordering takeaway; everyone will have come to terms with it, and naturally it will no longer be possible to legislate a ban.

text: 只是目前，确实不行，组建家庭或维系长期恋爱关系依然是社会上大部分人的选择。
en: Only for now, it really will not do; forming a family or maintaining a long-term relationship is still the choice of the majority of society.

text: 多看看裁判文书网，或者去法学论坛听听法官、检察官、法学行业人士对这个问题的讨论就行了。
en: Just look more at China Judgments Online, or go to law forums and listen to judges, prosecutors and legal professionals discuss this issue.

text: 1卖淫合法化与强奸犯罪，这两者之间一毛钱关系都没有，难道现在的强奸犯是因为找不到地方花钱才犯罪的吗？
en: 1. The legalisation of prostitution and the crime of rape have not a penny's worth of connection between them — do you think today's rapists commit crimes simply because they cannot find a place to spend money?

text: 2卖淫合法后不会只要漂亮的女人，只会造成分级，并催生黄赌毒、人口买卖和暴力犯罪。
en: 2. After prostitution is legalised, it will not be that only beautiful women are wanted; it will only create a hierarchy and give rise to vice, gambling and drugs, human trafficking and violent crime.

text: 总有弱势群体在社会上处于事实上的低人权状态。
en: There will always be vulnerable groups who, in society, exist in a state of de facto low human rights.

text: 3还记得被废止的嫖宿幼女罪吗？
en: 3. Do you still remember the abolished crime of patronising underage prostitutes?

text: 仔细观察法学论坛上支持卖淫合法化的人群，这些人与支持嫖宿幼女罪的人群高度重合，都属于不必担心自己后代被拐去卖淫，而对穷人家女儿抱有浓厚兴趣的人群。
en: Observe carefully the groups on law forums who support the legalisation of prostitution: these people overlap heavily with those who supported the crime of patronising underage prostitutes, and both belong to the sort who need not worry that their own offspring will be abducted into prostitution, yet harbour a keen interest in the daughters of poor families.

text: 这是一个屁股问题。
en: This is a matter of which side you are on.

text: 谁告诉你的卖淫合法之后强奸就会变少了？
en: Who told you that after prostitution is legalised, rape would decrease?

text: 哪儿来的逻辑？
en: What logic is that?

text: 这个社会卖淫虽然不合法，但是又不是绝迹了。
en: Although prostitution is illegal in this society, it is hardly extinct.

text: 哪个城市没有黄色产业？
en: Which city does not have a vice industry?

text: 而且从高端到低端还齐全得很。
en: And from high-end to low-end, it is fully stocked.

text: 强奸犯难道是因为找不到嫖的地方才去强奸的吗？
en: Do you think rapists rape precisely because they cannot find a place to buy sex?

text: 认真的还是搞笑呀？
en: Are you being serious or are you joking?

text: 实在找不到嫖的地方，现在这个社会各个有色软件下载一个摇一摇划一划嘛，只要想嫖，合法的不合法的多得要死，非要让卖淫合法干啥？
en: If you really cannot find a place to whore, in today's society you just download one of those various adult apps, give it a shake and a swipe; as long as you want to buy sex, there are legal and illegal options galore — so why on earth must prostitution be made legal?

text: 国外又不是没有合法的国家或地区，这些地方的强奸犯罪绝迹了吗？
en: It is not as if there are no foreign countries or regions where it is legal — has the crime of rape been eliminated in those places?

text: 你们消灭或者遏制另一种更严重的犯罪发生的方式就是让一种相关的犯罪行为合法？
en: Your way of eliminating or curbing another, more serious crime is to legalise a related criminal act?

text: 这跟为了遏制贩毒，所以让吸毒合法有啥区别？
en: What is the difference between this and legalising drug use in order to curb drug trafficking?

text: 这跟为了遏制被人枪杀，所以让持枪合法有啥区别？
en: What is the difference between this and legalising gun ownership in order to curb being shot?

text: 结局你们没看见吗？
en: Have you not seen the outcome?

text: 我就这么跟你说。
en: I will just tell you this straightforwardly.

text: 目前国内禁黄，打击黄色。
en: At present, domestically, pornography is prohibited and vice is cracked down on.

text: 当然有你说的那些原因 但是最主要的是 不是因为你想的那些原因。
en: Of course there are the reasons you mentioned, but the main one is not the reason you were thinking of.

text: 而是因为，不想让现阶段的现有国民，用少量的金钱得到精神满足。
en: Rather, it is because the state does not want the current population, at this stage, to obtain spiritual satisfaction with a small amount of money.

text: 国家还需要建设，社会还需要社畜。
en: The country still needs building, and society still needs wage slaves.

text: 房子还卖不卖，经济还要不要发展。
en: Are houses still to be sold or not, and is the economy to develop or not?

text: 不然你以为？
en: Otherwise, what did you think?
